summary: Route Finder shows the aircraft type for every flight.
releaseNotes: Every Route Finder flight shows its aircraft type: the exact one when that flight was seen in today’s live traffic, otherwise the airline’s typical type for the distance, marked TYPICAL.
Choosing an aircraft in Route Finder skips flights seen today on a different type.
